tasks.label: run-integration-stability
tasks.command: for /L %i in (1,1,5) do (cargo test --test integration > tmp_stab_task_run.txt 2>&1 & findstr /C:"test result: ok. 26 passed" tmp_stab_task_run.txt >nul && echo run=%i PASS >> tmp_stab_task.txt || echo run=%i FAILED >> tmp_stab_task.txt)

tasks.label: verify-grease-fix2
tasks.command: cargo bench --manifest-path benches/Cargo.toml --bench tmp_repro > tmp_verify_task2.txt 2>&1; Get-Content tmp_verify_task2.txt -Raw | Select-String -Pattern "QUINN-H3 repro outcome|COURIERUST-CLIENT phase|QUINN phase" | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }
